title: PR Branch Lock Schema
description: File-based distributed lock for coordinating single-agent mutations on GitHub PR branches

lock_id.description: Globally unique lock identifier; format: LOCK-{repo}-PR{number}

branch.description: Git branch name (usually matches PR head branch)

holder.description: Agent, tool, or user ID holding the lock (e.g., 'agent-dispatch-review-intake', 'claude-session-abc')

queue_item_id.description: Task/mission/queue item ID that acquired this lock (for traceability)

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when lock was acquired

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when lock expires and may be replaced
